_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or derived from extracted values by a rule stated beside it.

acres.basis: acres Port Alpha sits on at the Port of Brownsville

acres_option.basis: acres the site has an option to expand to, nearly

invest_b.basis: billions of dollars of private capital, more than, per Saronic

jobs.basis: direct jobs expected, up to, per Saronic

gross_tons_initial.basis: gross tons of annual shipbuilding capacity at opening

gross_tons_potential_m.basis: million gross tons the capacity could scale to, over

vessel_ft.basis: feet, the longest vessel the yard can build at first

vessel_future_ft.basis: feet, vessels the expanded site could build, over

enclosed_msf.basis: million square feet of enclosed production space

quay_ft.basis: feet of deepwater quay, more than

positions_min.basis: build positions for final ship erection, the low end

positions_max.basis: build positions for final ship erection, the high end

marauder_knots.basis: knots, the Marauder's top speed, 25+ per Saronic

marauder_range_nmi.basis: nautical miles, the Marauder's range, up to

marauder_payload_t.basis: metric tons, the Marauder's modular payload

tax_break_m.basis: millions of dollars, the tax break the Tribune reported

tribune_cost_b.basis: billions, the shipyard's cost as the Tribune wrote it in June

abatement_pct.basis: percent property tax abatement, as the Tribune reported

abatement_years.basis: years the abatement runs, as the Tribune reported

local_pct.basis: percent of the full time workforce required to be local residents

jobs_engineering.basis: engineering and design jobs, the Tribune's breakdown

edc_incentive_m.basis: millions, the Greater Brownsville EDC's additional incentive

navy_contract_m.basis: millions, the Navy contract the Tribune reported

vessel_m.basis: metres, the longest vessel at first

site_side_m.basis: metres on a side, the site drawn as a square of its own area
site_side_m.rule: sqrt(acres * 4046.8564224); a drawing rule, the parcel's real shape is not in the record

option_side_m.basis: metres on a side, the option drawn as a square of its own area

vessels_along_quay.basis: whole 850 foot hulls end to end along the quay, at least
vessels_along_quay.rule: quay_ft // vessel_ft, floor, since the quay is more than its stated length

abated_share_pct.basis: percent of the abated tax still owed in the abatement's terms

local_jobs_at_full.basis: local residents among the full workforce if the up to figure were reached
local_jobs_at_full.rule: jobs * local_pct / 100; a projection on a projection, never published as a count

option_multiple.basis: times the first site, the option to expand

payload_block_m3.basis: cubic metres of solid steel weighing the Marauder's payload
payload_block_m3.rule: payload_t / 7.85 t per m3, two decimals; a drawing rule for one block of steel

payload_block_edge_m.basis: metres on a side, that block drawn as a cube
payload_block_edge_m.rule: cube root of payload_block_m3, three decimals

crew_drawn.basis: workers drawn at the hull on frame 8

crew_local_drawn.basis: of those twenty, the share the 35% local requirement names
